figurative_meaning_en: To reap the consequences of past actions
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পুরনো ভুলের জেরটানা এখন সে ভোগ করছে।
জীবনে সবাই একদিন তার কর্মের জেরটানা পায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is now suffering the consequences of his past mistakes.
Everyone reaps the fruits of their deeds sooner or later.
note: The idiom draws from legal imagery but embodies the broader cultural concept of karmic retribution in Bengali society.
